Harness server (repository: harness)

Agent
go-developer (planning only, no code until the person approves)
Decision
The person chose A + B + C over one text view, with a size guard, plus F.
What changes at the boundary
  • read_task_document / read_project_document take offset/limit, section and view.
  • New search_documents across task documents, project documents and, optionally, text artifacts.
  • Document listings carry bytes, lines and version.
Constraints
  • Backward compatible: a call without the new arguments on a document under the guard returns exactly what it returns today, plus metadata.
  • Error messages begin with their code, because agents over MCP see messages only.
read_task_document { document_id, offset?, limit? }
  → { document, lines?, outline? }
